ogTitle: Where to Stay in Bang Tao–Laguna, Phuket
ogDesc: The best hotels in Bang Tao–Laguna by budget.
intro: Bang Tao is a roughly 6-kilometre stretch of sand on the island's north-west coast, much of it occupied by the Laguna Phuket complex — a cluster of branded resorts wrapped around lagoons and an 18-hole golf course. The surrounding Cherngtalay area adds well-known beach clubs, beachfront restaurants, and the Boat Avenue and Porto de Phuket lifestyle malls for walking, eating and shopping. The real draw is the calm resort atmosphere, an uncrowded beach, and a deep choice of mid-range to luxury stays. It works well for families, honeymooners and golfers. The trade-off is quiet nights and a 30–40 minute drive to Patong or the Old Town.

blocks.html: Short answer: Bang Tao–Laguna sits on Phuket's north-west coast, an upscale resort enclave fronting a long sandy beach with stylish beach clubs in the Cherngtalay area. It's about a 20–25 minute drive from the airport and suits travellers who want a relaxed stay well away from the buzz of Patong. Rates start around ฿2,900 for a beachfront resort and climb to tens of thousands for the pool villas inside the Laguna complex.

items.name: Best Western Premier Bangtao Beach Resort & Spa
items.meta: ★ 4-star · Best for: Value · beachfront families · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: The most affordable beachfront resort in the area, with outdoor lagoon pools, a kids' pool, a spa and a kids' club. Rooms are spacious with balconies, and some have sea views. Reviews praise the right-on-the-beach location, attentive staff and cleanliness. A good fit for families who want to be by the water on a sensible budget (breakfast and airport transfers are charged separately).

items.name: Cassia Phuket
items.meta: ★ 4-star · Best for: Self-catering · longer stays · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A Banyan Group aparthotel inside the Laguna complex, where studios and suites come with fully equipped kitchens. There are several outdoor pools, a grocery store, and a walk to the Porto de Phuket mall. Reviews single out the clean, modern rooms and value. A practical choice for families or longer stays who want to cook for themselves and use the wider Laguna facilities.

items.name: Mövenpick Resort Bangtao Beach Phuket
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: Families · pools · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 5-star resort on Bang Tao Beach known for its large pools and a range of rooms, including some with direct pool access from the terrace. There's a kids' club, a spa and several restaurants, plus the chocolate and dessert touches Mövenpick is known for. A solid pick for families who want a beachfront resort with plenty of activities and good pools.

items.name: SAii Laguna Phuket
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: Beachfront · modern design · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 5-star resort sitting directly on Bang Tao Beach, with a bright, modern design and a wide spread of room types — garden, lagoon and sea views. It has a beachfront pool, a kids' club and its own beach club, with the sand just steps away. Reviews praise the right-on-the-beach location and the lively feel. A good fit for couples and families wanting a contemporary seaside resort within Laguna.

items.name: Angsana Laguna Phuket
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: Phuket's longest pool · activities · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 5-star resort in the Laguna complex famous for its free-form pool that runs over 300 metres — the longest in Phuket. It has a strong kids' club, watersports and an award-winning spa, and sits on an island among the lagoons with a walk down to Bang Tao Beach. It scores highly on Tripadvisor, with guests praising the service. Best for families who want lots of activities and a pool as the centrepiece.

items.name: Dusit Thani Laguna Phuket
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: Golfers · Thai-style service · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 5-star beachfront resort in the Laguna complex, next to the 18-hole Laguna Golf Phuket course. Its calling cards are Thai-inspired architecture and gardens plus the warm Dusit Thani service. There are rooms and some pool-equipped units, a spa and several restaurants. Reviews praise the staff and the breakfast buffet. Ideal for golfers and anyone wanting a luxury resort with a distinctly Thai feel on the beach.

items.name: Banyan Tree Phuket
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: Honeymoon · private pool villas · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: An all-villa luxury resort in the Laguna complex, where every unit is a private villa or pool villa set around the lagoons. It has a renowned spa, several restaurants and a high degree of privacy. Best for honeymoons or special occasions where you want your own pool. Rates start high and some villas are still being refreshed, so it's worth requesting a renovated unit when booking — but for a luxury pool villa near Bang Tao Beach, this is the benchmark.

faq.q: Who is Bang Tao–Laguna best for?
faq.a: It suits families, honeymooners and golfers who want a calm beachfront resort away from the buzz of Patong. The area has a long, uncrowded beach, beach clubs and lifestyle malls for eating and shopping. If you want lively nightlife or to walk to lots of bars and shops, Patong is a better match.

faq.q: How far is Bang Tao from the airport and Patong?
faq.a: Phuket airport is fairly close, about a 20–25 minute drive, which makes arrivals and departures easy. Patong and the Old Town are further, roughly 30–40 minutes by car depending on traffic. There's no real public transport in the area, so most people use taxis, ride-hailing apps or a rental car.

faq.q: How is staying inside the Laguna complex different from the resorts around it?
faq.a: Hotels in the Laguna group (such as Banyan Tree, Angsana, Dusit Thani, SAii and Cassia) sit around the same shared lagoons and golf course, and guests can often use some facilities across properties, with internal shuttle boats and buggies. Resorts like Best Western and Mövenpick are on Bang Tao Beach itself, just outside the complex, with direct access to the sand. Choose Laguna for golf and full shared facilities; choose the outer beachfront resorts for direct beach access and lower prices.
